---
title: "Module 11: Spatial cell-type annotation with SingleR"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-12"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# Integrated SingleR + inferCNV annotation and Figure 7 plots
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Override SingleR identities for inferCNV malignant-enriched spots while
#   retaining SingleR identities for all other spots.
#
#   Generate:
#     1. Integrated annotation UMAP
#     2. Four spatial annotation maps
#     3. Combined 2 x 2 spatial annotation figure
#     4. Four-sample proportional composition plot
#
# Original SingleR labels are retained in:
#   predicted_spot_identity
#
# Integrated labels are stored in:
#   integrated_spot_identity


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Output directories
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "singleR"
)

singleR_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "singleR"
)

dir.create(
  singleR_figure_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  singleR_results_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Annotation settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_column <- "predicted_spot_identity"

malignancy_column <- "malignancy_annotation"

malignant_label <- "Malignant-enriched"

integrated_column <- "integrated_spot_identity"


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Check required metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

required_columns <- c(
  singleR_column,
  malignancy_column
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(spatial_singleR@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required metadata columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create integrated annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Malignant-enriched spots override the SingleR prediction.
# All other spots retain their SingleR-predicted identity.

spatial_singleR[[integrated_column]] <- ifelse(
  spatial_singleR@meta.data[[malignancy_column]] == malignant_label,
  malignant_label,
  as.character(spatial_singleR@meta.data[[singleR_column]])
)

spatial_singleR[[integrated_column]] <- factor(
  spatial_singleR@meta.data[[integrated_column]]
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Inspect integrated identities
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

integrated_identity_counts <- spatial_singleR@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    .data[[integrated_column]],
    name = "n_spots"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_spots)
  )

print(
  integrated_identity_counts
)


write.csv(
  integrated_identity_counts,
  file.path(
    singleR_results_directory,
    "integrated_identity_counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate malignant spot override
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

n_infercnv_malignant <- sum(
  spatial_singleR@meta.data[[malignancy_column]] == malignant_label,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_integrated_malignant <- sum(
  spatial_singleR@meta.data[[integrated_column]] == malignant_label,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

message(
  "inferCNV malignant-enriched spots: ",
  n_infercnv_malignant
)

message(
  "Integrated malignant-enriched spots: ",
  n_integrated_malignant
)

if (n_infercnv_malignant != n_integrated_malignant) {
  stop(
    "Malignant spot counts do not match after annotation integration."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Create integrated color palette
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

integrated_identities <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      spatial_singleR@meta.data[[integrated_column]]
    )
  )
)

integrated_colors <- setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(
    length(integrated_identities)
  ),
  integrated_identities
)

if (malignant_label %in% names(integrated_colors)) {
  integrated_colors[malignant_label] <- "#D73027"
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Integrated annotation UMAP
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"umap" %in% names(spatial_singleR@reductions)) {
  stop(
    "UMAP reduction was not found in spatial_singleR."
  )
}

integrated_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_singleR,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = integrated_column,
  cols = integrated_colors,
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  labs(
    title = "Integrated SingleR and inferCNV spot identities"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

print(
  integrated_umap
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    singleR_figure_directory,
    "integrated_identity_UMAP.png"
  ),
  plot = integrated_umap,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Define spatial samples
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Use the image names already present in the Seurat object.
# These correspond to the four sections shown in Figure 7.

print(
  names(spatial_singleR@images)
)


spatial_map_settings <- data.frame(
  image = names(spatial_singleR@images),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# Require exactly four spatial sections for this dataset.

if (nrow(spatial_map_settings) != 4) {
  stop(
    "Expected four spatial images but found ",
    nrow(spatial_map_settings),
    ". Check names(spatial_singleR@images)."
  )
}


# Assign the biological display names used in Figure 7.

spatial_map_settings$display_name <- c(
  "Normal Tissue",
  "Vehicle 1",
  "Vehicle 2",
  "Niacin Treatment"
)


print(
  spatial_map_settings
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Add sample identity from spatial image membership
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Do not rely on a pre-existing sample column.
# Instead, assign each spot directly from the image it belongs to.

spatial_singleR$figure7_sample <- NA_character_


for (i in seq_len(nrow(spatial_map_settings))) {

  image_name <- spatial_map_settings$image[i]

  display_name <- spatial_map_settings$display_name[i]

  image_cells <- Cells(
    spatial_singleR[[image_name]]
  )

  image_cells <- intersect(
    image_cells,
    colnames(spatial_singleR)
  )

  spatial_singleR$figure7_sample[
    colnames(spatial_singleR) %in% image_cells
  ] <- display_name
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Validate sample assignment
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

sample_assignment_counts <- spatial_singleR@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    figure7_sample,
    name = "n_spots"
  )


print(
  sample_assignment_counts
)


if (any(is.na(spatial_singleR$figure7_sample))) {
  warning(
    sum(is.na(spatial_singleR$figure7_sample)),
    " spots could not be assigned to a Figure 7 sample."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Spatial maps
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

integrated_spatial_plots <- list()


for (i in seq_len(nrow(spatial_map_settings))) {

  image_name <- spatial_map_settings$image[i]

  display_name <- spatial_map_settings$display_name[i]


  current_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
    spatial_singleR,
    images = image_name,
    group.by = integrated_column,
    cols = integrated_colors,
    pt.size.factor = 1.6,
    alpha = 1,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
    labs(
      title = display_name
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )


  print(
    current_plot
  )


  integrated_spatial_plots[[display_name]] <- current_plot


  safe_name <- gsub(
    " ",
    "_",
    tolower(display_name)
  )


  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      singleR_figure_directory,
      paste0(
        "integrated_spatial_",
        safe_name,
        ".png"
      )
    ),
    plot = current_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Combined 2 x 2 spatial plot
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

integrated_spatial_combined <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  integrated_spatial_plots,
  ncol = 2,
  guides = "collect"
) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )


print(
  integrated_spatial_combined
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    singleR_figure_directory,
    "integrated_spatial_all_samples.png"
  ),
  plot = integrated_spatial_combined,
  width = 18,
  height = 14,
  dpi = 600,
  limitsize = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Calculate sample-wise integrated composition
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

sample_order <- c(
  "Normal Tissue",
  "Vehicle 1",
  "Vehicle 2",
  "Niacin Treatment"
)


integrated_composition <- spatial_singleR@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(figure7_sample)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    figure7_sample,
    .data[[integrated_column]],
    name = "n_spots"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    figure7_sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_spots = sum(n_spots),
    proportion = n_spots / total_spots
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


integrated_composition$figure7_sample <- factor(
  integrated_composition$figure7_sample,
  levels = sample_order
)


print(
  integrated_composition
)


# Check that each sample sums to exactly 1.

composition_check <- integrated_composition %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    figure7_sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_proportion = sum(proportion),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(
  composition_check
)


write.csv(
  integrated_composition,
  file.path(
    singleR_results_directory,
    "integrated_spot_composition_by_sample.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Plot sample-wise integrated composition
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

integrated_composition_plot <- ggplot(
  integrated_composition,
  aes(
    x = figure7_sample,
    y = proportion,
    fill = .data[[integrated_column]]
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = integrated_colors
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Integrated spot composition by sample",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of spatial spots",
    fill = "Spot identity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )


print(
  integrated_composition_plot
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    singleR_figure_directory,
    "integrated_spot_composition_by_sample.png"
  ),
  plot = integrated_composition_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Save integrated spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

integrated_object_file <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "singleR",
  "spatial_singleR_infercnv_integrated.rds"
)


saveRDS(
  spatial_singleR,
  integrated_object_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Final summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Integrated SingleR + inferCNV annotation complete."
)

message(
  ncol(spatial_singleR),
  " total spatial spots."
)

message(
  n_integrated_malignant,
  " malignant-enriched spots."
)

message(
  "Figures saved to: ",
  singleR_figure_directory
)

message(
  "Object saved to: ",
  integrated_object_file
)
```
